title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Fahim Reza Divi Contact…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Divi Contact Form 7 plugin (cf7-styler-for-divi) up to version 4.1.0. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, enabling code injection. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3. No official patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
